blocks.text: Har gurde ke bilkul oopar aik adrenal gland hai. Har aik ka andaruni hissa adrenal medulla aur bahari hissa adrenal cortex hai. Medulla nervous system aur cortex anterior pituitary ke hormones ke qaboo mein hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: gurda jis ke oopar adrenal gland topi ki tarah rakha hai. Teer daen taraf adrenal gland ki tarash tak jata hai: bahar patla capsule (ghilaf), mota peela cortex, aur andar gehra medulla jis mein khoon ki nalyan (blood vessels) hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.5: Adrenal gland (kitab ki Figure 16.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Adrenal medulla: epinephrine aur norepinephrine (adrenaline aur noradrenaline), jo tanao mein jism ko lado ya bhago ke liye tayyar karte hain: tez dharkan, zyada blood pressure, chauri bronchioles, zyada khoon ka glucose aur jild aur hazme ke aaza ko kam khoon.

Adrenal cortex: corticosteroids. Cortisol jaise glucocorticoids glucose ka tawazun rakhte hain: muscle ka protein amino acids mein turwate jinhein jigar glucose mein badalta hai (gluconeogenesis). Aldosterone jaise mineralocorticoids maadni tawazun rakhte hain: gurdon se sodium aur us ke saath pani wapas jazb karwa kar khoon ka hajm aur pressure naarmal rakhte, aur zaid potassium peshab mein dalwate hain.
Medulla: zyada se hypertension aur rozmarra mein jarehana rawayya ho sakta; kam se jism hangami halat ka muqabla nahi kar pata.

Cushing disease: zyada cortisol, jab pituitary zyada ACTH banaye; protein ka zyada tootna zyada blood sugar, zyada blood pressure, patli haddiyan, muscle ki kami, patli nazuk jild, udasi aur auraton mein chehre par zyada baal laata hai.
Addison's disease: kam cortisol, aam metabolic bigaar, muscles ki kamzori aur namak ki kami; alamaat aam taur par aahista aati hain.

blocks.prompt: Kisi ko achanak khatra pesh aata hai. Adrenal gland ka kaunsa hissa pehle jawab deta hai, aur us ka hormone bronchioles ke saath kya karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Adrenal medulla, nervous qaboo mein, epinephrine chhorta hai jo bronchioles ko phailata hai (dharkan aur khoon ka glucose barhane ke saath).

items: Medulla (nerves): epinephrine, norepinephrine, lado ya bhago. Cortex (ACTH): cortisol (glucose), aldosterone (sodium, pani, potassium).
